# Week 8a {.unnumbered}
You sell a product with a price of £20 per unit. The variable cost associated with the product is £10 per unit. The fixed costs associated with the product is £20,000. How many products should you sell to make a target profit of £10,000?

Answer:

$Break-even \ quantity = \frac{Fixed \ cost}{Contribution}$

$Contribution = Selling \ Price - Variable \ Cost$

$Break-even \ quantity = \frac{20000}{20-10}$ = `r 20000/10`

You must sell 2000 units to achieve break-even.
